files.name: inn-natural-v3
files.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: production 2D RPG whole-map background, opaque. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET tavern map. Input image 2 is a COLOR AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY, a cool grey stone hall; do not copy its architecture or layout. Repaint ONLY the lighting and material colors of target image 1. Preserve precisely its complete overhead map layout, camera, crop, aspect ratio, plank directions, walls, gaps, doorways, furniture silhouettes, furniture positions, small tabletop items and lantern positions. The current tavern is excessively orange and yellow everywhere. Make it a believable inhabited medieval tavern: weathered oak floor in natural muted grey-brown and desaturated walnut with subtle varied woodgrain, cool grey stone trim and plaster, green living plants, aged dark iron, off-white parchment. Main ambient light neutral daylight, clear surface texture, shadows mildly cool. Retain vivid small amber flames and localized warm pools ONLY immediately beside existing lanterns/candles, warmth fades rapidly into the neutral room. Keep useful natural brown colors, rich red cloth, green plants and brass details rather than applying a uniform grey filter. Floor must look grey-brown old wood rather than honey/gold/orange varnish. Do not add, remove or move any objects. No people, no UI, no letters, no additional candles, no extra decor. Keep existing game-space geography exact. Preserve opaque image and original 1330x1182 canvas if supported.
